body:
Freeze the v2.1 changes the human asked for after trying the v2 flow, as an approved spec, before the 18 Oct 2026 submission.

Spec: .adlc/specs/SC-019-v21-wizard-real-offers.md (builds on the approved SC-014 spec; every SC-014 rule stays unless that spec lists it under Supersedes).

Scope of this ticket: the spec file only. No application code until the human approves the spec (P1 Gate 1) and it is decomposed.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The spec lints with every criterion verifiable. Verify: adlc spec-lint .adlc/specs/SC-019-v21-wizard-real-offers.md
2. A premortem is recorded against the spec. Verify: adlc run p1 --ticket SC-019
title: Freeze the v2.1 spec: wizard, bounded date, add items, receipt upload, suggestions, multi-buy promotions, real bank offers, up to four stores, mock partners and delivery
